callback_semantics: There is no restriction, validator, timeout wrapper, worker isolation or callback cancellation in wait_notification. A construction may supply a new deliberately gated predicate, but must not call that an observed live application predicate.

Default threading.Condition uses a reentrant lock. Same-thread acquisition such as latest_turn_usage may succeed. Reentrant request/notification calls may invoke Condition.wait and release the condition while the outer callback is outstanding, so the simple exclusion inference applies only when the callback actually retains the condition.

A callback which mutates/reenters notification consumption can invalidate the outer deque iterator/index: iterator continuation may raise mutation RuntimeError, and a true branch may delete a now-different index or raise IndexError. This is not the proposed pure gated causal fixture and is not experimentally verified here.

Exceptions from predicate or its truth-value conversion propagate; the outer with releases the condition, but source does not otherwise remove the current notification. Callback side effects remain arbitrary.
Predicate truth-value evaluation must remain outside the condition in the comparator, not merely the callable invocation, because an arbitrary returned object may implement blocking __bool__.

comparator.decision: Justified as strongest simple comparator for bounded causal evidence under pure, nonmutating fixture callbacks and JSON notification rows. Not reviewed or proposed for production adoption.
algorithm: Under condition, snapshot ordered notification object references. Release condition before predicate evaluation and truth-value conversion.

For a true snapshot selection, reacquire condition, find that SAME object using is, and remove only its current index if still present. If absent, resnapshot/retry rather than returning stale selection or removing by old index.
Do not use deque.remove(message), message in deque, equality, or a stale snapshot index: distinct JSON rows may compare equal and equality is not identity.

After a full no-match scan, reacquire condition and compare current ordered queue references to the snapshot by identity (or use a correctly maintained queue-generation counter). If queue changed, rescan before sleeping. Only an unchanged queue permits atomic deadline/closed check plus Condition.wait. This avoids a notification arriving/notify_all firing during callback evaluation being lost before waiter sleeps.

Keep original match-before-deadline/closed behavior if claiming preservation of queued matching values, including values already queued at EOF or after the deadline. Adding a match cutoff would be a second intervention.
races_and_limits: Two waiters may evaluate the same snapshot object; only the first identity-checked remover returns it. The loser must resnapshot and may select another object or wait. Callback invocation count/fairness may differ.

Holding snapshot references prevents object-ID reuse for the selected object. Identity recheck establishes membership/at-most-once removal, not payload immutability, callback purity, global ordering or linearization of arbitrary callback side effects.

Reader append and waiter removal can proceed during callback evaluation. Fresh snapshots must honor queue order among currently available objects, but exact callback ordering across concurrent waiters is not preserved.

Moving callback outside condition does not bound the callback, notification call, snapshots over unbounded queue growth, journal/write/kernel I/O or close; it targets independent condition progress only.

Identity queue-check before waiting is necessary for a general outside-lock waiter. If omitted in a tightly controlled fixture, explicitly limit evidence to that schedule rather than claim an equivalent API.

suggested_discriminating_controls.name: request_first_pressure
suggested_discriminating_controls.purpose: Separate response publication/reacquisition obstruction from pre-deadline ID allocation.
requirements: Start independent request first; require owned peer request-received record and an actual live request deadline/Condition.wait frame before releasing notification-emission gate.
Require actual callback-enter record with the intended object queued; keep callback on separate bounded owner release event that does not release client condition in baseline.

Only then open owned peer emit-response gate. Native wire response or journal received response is not proof of publication: _record occurs before reader condition acquisition. Capture reader condition-acquisition frame, request still waiting/reacquiring, and observed monotonic deadline past due.
Keep journal writes regular/nonblocking or disable consistently; healthy peer drains the small request. This pressure must not be assigned to journal mutex or write-lock owners.

Release predicate separately after fixed checkpoint; retain all first outcomes, caller/reader/owned peer cleanup, actual IDs/clocks/source frames and outer receipts. Candidate independent request should finish while notification callback and notification caller remain pending.

suggested_discriminating_controls.name: healthy
suggested_discriminating_controls.purpose: Same source/protocol/notification/reply content with promptly returning predicate; exact intended response/notification must be returned and notification consumed once in each arm.

suggested_discriminating_controls.name: overlapping_waiter_stale_identity
suggested_discriminating_controls.purpose: While comparator waiter A evaluates selected object outside lock, waiter B consumes that exact object. Queue an equal-by-value but distinct object, then let A return true. A must not return already-consumed object or delete equal-but-distinct object using stale index/equality; exact identity consumption records discriminate. Callback/event ordering bounded and owned. Original serialization is an acknowledged semantic difference, not failed original at-most-once control.

suggested_discriminating_controls.name: no_match_queue_change
suggested_discriminating_controls.purpose: Optional construction control: append a matching notification while comparator is evaluating a false snapshot entry, before it attempts wait. It must rescan rather than miss the prior notify_all.
